review_candidates.title: Fullstack Engineer / AI Engineer for BRAIINS MANAGER
review_candidates.description: Braiins Systems Prague or fully remote Full-time (employee or freelance) We build the software that runs a meaningful share of the world's Bitcoin mining hardware. Alongside our flagship Braiins OS+ and Braiins Pool (the world's first Bitcoin mining pool), we build Braiins Manager — the cloud platform for remote fleet management — and the desktop tooling that goes with it. We're looking for a fullstack engineer who is equally comfortable shipping a feature end to end and building the AI tooling the rest of the team develops with. Not a prompt specialist bolted onto a product team — an engineer who happens to be very good at getting real work out of models. ⚙️ What You'll Actually Work On You'll own features across the full lifecycle: architecture and design, implementation on both sides of the wire, then troubleshooting it in production when a customer with thousands of miners hits an edge you didn't predict. The platform. A NestJS/TypeScript API on PostgreSQL, with Redis, queue-driven background work (BullMQ, Kafka) and gRPC where devices talk to us. An Angular dashboard, a React desktop frontend, and a Rust daemon in between. It all runs containerised on our own Kubernetes. The AI half. We run an internal agent platform: a shared library of agent skills and MCP servers wired into our repos, plus an orchestration pipeline that carries a product idea through discovery, design, stories and implementation with a human approval gate at each stage. Real infrastructure with real users — our own team — so it's treated like production: evaluated, versioned, observable, honest about what it can't do. You'd work on agent and tool design, MCP integrations, context engineering, retrieval over our domain data, and the evals that keep it from silently degrading. Where AI belongs in the product itself is still open, and we'd like your help answering it. You'll join an international, multidisciplinary, fully remote team , with a flat structure and short paths to a decision. 🔍 What We're Looking For Strong TypeScript, both ends. Node.js on the server (NestJS or equivalent) and a modern SPA framework (Angular, React, Vue). Real depth on one side, genuine competence on the other — we're not looking for someone who "also touches the frontend." SQL that goes past the ORM. PostgreSQL, relational modeling, migrations, and the judgement to know when the query builder is the wrong tool. Hands-on experience shipping with LLMs. Tool/function calling, MCP, retrieval, agent orchestration, evals — any credible subset. Equally valid: you've pushed coding agents hard enough on real codebases to have opinions about where they break. Git, Docker, CI. The daily toolchain, not a checkbox: readable history and clean branches, a service you can containerise yourself, and a pipeline you can fix when it goes red. Kubernetes is a plus, not a gate. Comfort with asynchronous, distributed systems. Queues, at-least-once delivery, idempotent handlers, retries and backpressure — and what each of those costs. Microservice architecture, observability stacks, time-series or telemetry data at scale. REST and gRPC; a working understanding of what's underneath them. Tests you'd defend in review — unit and integration, and the judgement to pick. Debugging as a core skill. Reading a stack trace, a slow query plan and a metrics dashboard with equal comfort. Solid grasp of algorithms and data structures. English at a communicative level, and the self-direction a remote team needs. ✨ Nice to have — genuinely optional Rust. We have a real Rust codebase and you can go as deep into it as you want. It is not a requirement and not something we screen on — if you come from C, C++ or Go, or simply want to learn it here, that's a welcome bonus, nothing more. Python — our agent orchestration tooling lives there. Frontend craft: design systems, accessibility, bundle and rendering performance. An interest in Bitcoin or active experience with cryptocurrencies. 🎉 What we offer Full-time position with flexible working hours, employee or freelance. Indefinite contract. For employees: 5 weeks of vacation and 3 sick days. Fully remote, with modern offices in the centre of Prague if you want them — relaxation room, shower, parking. Company events and the occasional Braiins brunch. A generous budget for AI tooling, and the freedom to use it properly. Long-term work on products used daily by industrial-scale mining operations. Interested? Tell us what you've built — a repo, a system you're proud of, or an agent setup that actually earns its keep. We'd rather read that than a cover letter.

review_candidates.title: Principal Flight Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Please review the job details below. Lanteris Space LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Intuitive Machines, is currently seeking a Principal Embedded Flight Software Engineer to join our team in our Palo Alto, CA offices. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. with periodic visits to our Palo Alto location. In this role, you will work on a variety of challenging projects including NASA’s Artemis program, the Power Propulsion Element. Intuitive Machines is a leading space infrastructure company that builds spacecraft, connects networks, and operates infrastructure-as-a-service for commercial, civil, and national security customers. With a proven track record across the space domain, the Company, through organic growth and portfolio expansion, has built over 300 spacecraft, delivered over 260 kilograms of payload to the lunar surface, and provided precision navigation expertise that has guided spacecraft across our solar system. Responsibilities Design and implement software for embedded Real-time Operating Systems (RTOS). Develop, document, and maintain architectures, requirements, algorithms, interfaces, and designs for flight software systems. Develop software verification plans, unit level and open loop test suites, and procedures, executing the test procedures and documenting test results to ensure that software system requirements are met. Perform software product life cycle management. Develop, select, tailor, and deploy software processes, tools, and metrics. Serve as a subject matter expert for software domains, processes, and system-specific issues. Minimum Requirements Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or related field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree. 15 years of software development experience Embedded C++ programing skills on multicore-processor architecture VxWorks and cFS experience Ability to travel to Palo Alto, CA office as needed In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings. The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range. The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $146,000.00 - $244,000.00 annually. The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $146,000.00 - $244,000.00 annually. The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $146,000.00 - $244,000.00 annually. The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $161,000.00 - $269,000.00 annually. The base pay for this position within California is: $168,000.00 - $280,000.00 annually. For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process. Additionally, this position is incentive eligible with a target based on contribution, company performance, and/or individual results achieved; the specific incentive plan and target amount will be determined based on the role and breadth of contributions. The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job posting. To apply, submit your application via the Lanteris Space Systems Career page. Lanteris Space Systems values diversity in the workplace and is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
